column1: # packages components, computed: a mode per package manager on PATH (see lib/components.sh for the table
# format). apt's available and upgradable lists are cached (source.sh); snap-available, flatpak-available
row mode apt - 'apt: installed packages (dependencies dim)' default
row mode available - 'apt: every package the archives offer (installed ones marked)' -
row mode upgradable - 'apt: installed packages with a newer version' -
for m in snap snap-available flatpak flatpak-available pipx cargo pnpm gem; do
snap) packages::has snap && row mode snap - 'snaps' "$default" ;;
row mode snap-available - 'every snap in the store, by name (details fetched for the preview)' - ;;
flatpak) packages::has flatpak && row mode flatpak - 'flatpak applications (runtimes with the runtimes toggle)' "$default" ;;
row mode flatpak-available - "the remotes' applications (their appstream data)" - ;;
pipx) packages::has pipx && row mode pipx - 'pipx applications' "$default" ;;
cargo) packages::has cargo && row mode cargo - 'cargo install crates, with their source' "$default" ;;
pnpm) packages::has pnpm && row mode pnpm - 'pnpm global packages' "$default" ;;
gem) packages::has gem && row mode gem - 'gems you installed (user and system; the ones apt owns left out)' "$default" ;;
row mode search - 'search crates.io, npm and rubygems.org as you type (and PyPI by exact name)' 'nopersist'
((apt)) && row toggle manual alt-m 'apt: only packages installed by hand, not as dependencies' -
packages::has flatpak && row toggle runtimes - 'flatpak: runtimes and extensions too' -
crates) row toggle crates - 'search: crates.io (cargo)' on ;;
npm) row toggle npm - 'search: the npm registry (pnpm)' on ;;
rubygems) row toggle rubygems - 'search: rubygems.org' on ;;
pypi) row toggle pypi - 'search: PyPI, the query as an exact name (pipx)' on ;;
# by name everywhere but search, whose order is the registries' relevance
row sort name - "${scope// /, }: by name" default
((apt)) && row sort size - 'apt: largest installed size first' -
row action upgrade alt-u 'upgrade to the latest version (sudo for apt, snap and system gems)' 'foreground,reload'
row action remove alt-x 'remove, asking first (apt asks itself; sudo for apt, snap and system gems)' 'foreground,reload'
((apt)) && row action purge - 'apt, available, upgradable: remove with the configuration files (apt asks)' 'foreground,reload'
